newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 2c to 577c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 2c to 577c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool eastern market indicator rose by 2.0 cents to 577 cents a kg clean at sales in Geelong on Tuesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19/25 micron indicators slightly dearer and 20/21m 0.5 percent dearer.
The 22/23m categories were up to 0.5 percent cheaper while 24m was unchanged, WI said.
In crossbreds, 26m was slightly cheaper and 27m slightly dearer.
The 28/29m classes were 1.0 percent dearer and 30/31m 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were 2.0 percent dearer, locks 3.0 percent dearer and crutchings unchanged.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with good support from Taiwan and Western Europe.
Of 15,213 bales offered, 9.4 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with about 35,900 bales to be offered.
